newsitem.title: ITALY: ENI says 2nd tranche sale to start Oct 21.
newsitem.headline: ENI says 2nd tranche sale to start Oct 21.

text.p: Italian energy giant ENI said stock market authority Consob had approved the prospectus for the second tranche of its share sale set to start on October 21.

ENI added that the amount of the second tranche of shares to be offered to investors has not been set yet, but the state, which at the moment holds 85 percent of the shares, will retain control of the group.

Details of the second tranche of shares will be announced on October 7. The first tranche of 15 percent of ENI shares was floated at 5,250 lire a share late last year. The shares trade in Milan, London and New York.
ENI shares closed in Milan off 1.13 percent at 6,922 lire.
The Italian Treasury said in a note that it will hold a news conference at 1500 GMT on September 19 on the share flotation prospectus.
